Step of fz-t93. Page (approved 2026-11-15): /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-t93.21.html (https://claude.ai/artifact/T8g3SUrZGsLA52McMMfdQo). Research: scratch t93_21/r/report.md, probe_AC.diff.

join_assign reports whether the value changed (all five impls); an unchanged entry ends ContributionMap::apply with no refold and no compare; rebuild runs only when rows changed; the fold over contributors rebuilds once, keeping the activation-input budget check inside the fold. Deletes the free fn join_contributions's per-apply refold path, the clone-and-compare in apply's exact arm, the unconditional rebuild in join_assign, the per-contributor rebuild in the fold. A refold counter joins the completion telemetry (approved) so the red test observes it.

Measured on develop d032c7368: activation-input block ~335M (2.7%); 6,023 of 9,123 applies had an unchanged entry; distiller 12.278G -> 12.182G (-0.78%, n=3 interleaved), output byte-identical. Predictions: refolds 9,123 -> ~3,100, rebuilds ~18k -> ~6k, no pin moves (watch activation_input_collapses). Bar: byte-identical output, no pin rises without approval.
title: Activation-input contributions cost the World in proportion to what changed
